title: Zesty Garlicky Portuguese Kabocha Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Portuguese dish featuring tender kabocha squash, perfect for a post-workout meal. This keto-friendly recipe is garlicky and delicious.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the katsuramuki-cut kabocha squash and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add the chicken broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes, until the squash is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
